title: BiasEye: A Bias-Aware Real-time Interactive Material Screening System for Impartial Candidate Assessment
reasoning: The paper focuses on human cognitive biases (e.g., recency, anchoring, halo effect) and how they impact the consistency and fairness of candidate screening in admissions/hiring. It proposes a system called BiasEye to help human reviewers recognize these personal biases. It does not evaluate religion, spiritual traditions, or specific moral/ethical philosophies.
